source_text: 1Hero… Helping your friend move in?

structure.raw_value: JoFrOp^.1Hero… Helping your friend move in?
structure.script_literal: "JoFrOp^.1Hero… Helping your friend move in?"

translation: 1Hero… Pomagasz przyjaciółce się wprowadzać?

source_text: She’s pretty excited. I hope you go easy on her.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.She’s pretty excited. I hope you go easy on her.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.She’s pretty excited. I hope you go easy on her."

translation: Jest bardzo podekscytowana. Mam nadzieję, że będziesz dla niej łagodny.

source_text: I am eager to rent from you, Jon. Do you have the key?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.I am eager to rent from you, Jon. Do you have the key?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.I am eager to rent from you, Jon. Do you have the key?"

translation: Chcę wynająć od ciebie, Jon. Masz klucz?

source_text: This place is pretty nice.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.This place is pretty nice.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.This place is pretty nice."

translation: To miejsce jest całkiem niezłe.

source_text: And it’s right next to where I work.

structure.raw_value: JuHaEx.And it’s right next to where I work.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaEx.And it’s right next to where I work."

translation: I jest tuż obok mojej pracy.

source_text: I know how to buy in the right locations.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx^.I know how to buy in the right locations.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx^.I know how to buy in the right locations."

translation: Wiem, jak kupować w dobrych lokalizacjach.

source_text: Thank you so much, Jon.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Thank you so much, Jon.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Thank you so much, Jon."

translation: Dziękuję ci bardzo, Jon.

source_text: Where’s all your stuff? Only bringing one bag?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe^.Where’s all your stuff? Only bringing one bag?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe^.Where’s all your stuff? Only bringing one bag?"

translation: Gdzie wszystkie twoje rzeczy? Tylko jedna torba?

source_text: Oh… I don’t have much.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Oh… I don’t have much.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Oh… I don’t have much."

translation: Och… Nie mam wiele.

source_text: I’m sure she’ll have a good time decorating this place.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’m sure she’ll have a good time decorating this place.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’m sure she’ll have a good time decorating this place."

translation: Jestem pewna, że będzie się świetnie bawić, urządzając to miejsce.

source_text: Just be careful not to put too many holes in the drywall when hanging pictures.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx^.Just be careful not to put too many holes in the drywall when hanging pictures.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx^.Just be careful not to put too many holes in the drywall when hanging pictures."

translation: Tylko uważaj, by nie zrobić za wielu dziur w ścianach, wieszając obrazy.

source_text: I need to take more pictures!

structure.raw_value: JuHaAg.I need to take more pictures!
structure.script_literal: "JuHaAg.I need to take more pictures!"

translation: Muszę robić więcej zdjęć!

source_text: You’ll keep an eye on her, right, Jon?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You’ll keep an eye on her, right, Jon?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You’ll keep an eye on her, right, Jon?"

translation: Będziesz miał na nią oko, prawda, Jon?

source_text: You can trust me, 1Hero. Just make sure she’s on-time with payments.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx^.You can trust me, 1Hero. Just make sure she’s on-time with payments.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx^.You can trust me, 1Hero. Just make sure she’s on-time with payments."

translation: Możesz mi zaufać, 1Hero. Tylko dopilnuj, by płaciła na czas.

source_text: You don’t have to worry about that. I have a job at Dick’s now.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.You don’t have to worry about that. I have a job at Dick’s now.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.You don’t have to worry about that. I have a job at Dick’s now."

translation: Nie musisz się martwić. Mam pracę w Dick's.

source_text: Good luck. I could never work in the fast-food biz.

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe^.Good luck. I could never work in the fast-food biz.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe^.Good luck. I could never work in the fast-food biz."

translation: Powodzenia. Nigdy nie dałbym rady w fast foodzie.

source_text: I think Judy is cut out for it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I think Judy is cut out for it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I think Judy is cut out for it."

translation: Myślę, że Judy się do tego nadaje.

source_text: I know I will succeed.

structure.raw_value: JuHaAg.I know I will succeed.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaAg.I know I will succeed."

translation: Wiem, że dam radę.

source_text: That’s the spirit… Good luck.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx^.That’s the spirit… Good luck.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx^.That’s the spirit… Good luck."

translation: To duch… Powodzenia.

source_text: Ah! Did you see that!?

structure.raw_value: JuShClNo1.Ah! Did you see that!?
structure.script_literal: "JuShClNo1.Ah! Did you see that!?"

translation: A! Widziałaś to!?

source_text: I saw a dog!

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I saw a dog!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I saw a dog!"

translation: Widziałam psa!

source_text: That’s… impossible.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.That’s… impossible.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.That’s… impossible."

translation: To… niemożliwe.

source_text: Holy shit! That’s a rat!

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1.Holy shit! That’s a rat!
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1.Holy shit! That’s a rat!"

translation: Jasna cholera! To szczur!

source_text: Ahh! It’s so huge!

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Ahh! It’s so huge!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Ahh! It’s so huge!"

translation: Aaa! Jaki ogromny!

source_text: God damn it… Jon’s apartments have rats?

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.God damn it… Jon’s apartments have rats?
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.God damn it… Jon’s apartments have rats?"

translation: Cholera… W apartamentach Jona są szczury?

source_text: No! No!... It’s okay. I think it was a dog. I like dogs.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.No! No!... It’s okay. I think it was a dog. I like dogs.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.No! No!... It’s okay. I think it was a dog. I like dogs."

translation: Nie! Nie!... W porządku. Chyba to był pies. Lubię psy.

source_text: Judy… It was a rat and you shouldn’t be living with rats.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Judy… It was a rat and you shouldn’t be living with rats.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Judy… It was a rat and you shouldn’t be living with rats."

translation: Judy… To był szczur i nie powinnaś mieszkać ze szczurami.

source_text: But, 1Hero, I love this place. It’s my home.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.But, 1Hero, I love this place. It’s my home.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.But, 1Hero, I love this place. It’s my home."

translation: Ale, 1Hero, kocham to miejsce. To mój dom.

source_text: Can we catch it and set him free?... Then I won’t have to live with a rat.

structure.raw_value: JuHaEx.Can we catch it and set him free?... Then I won’t have to live with a rat.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaEx.Can we catch it and set him free?... Then I won’t have to live with a rat."

translation: Możemy go złapać i wypuścić?... Wtedy nie będę musiała żyć ze szczurem.

source_text: That’s something Jon should do.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.That’s something Jon should do.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.That’s something Jon should do."

translation: To powinien zrobić Jon.

source_text: Please, 1Hero. I do not want to get on his bad side. Can’t we just catch it?

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.Please, 1Hero. I do not want to get on his bad side. Can’t we just catch it?
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.Please, 1Hero. I do not want to get on his bad side. Can’t we just catch it?"

translation: Proszę, 1Hero. Nie chcę mu podpaść. Nie możemy go po prostu złapać?

source_text: Fine… I’ll help trap the rat.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Fine… I’ll help trap the rat.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Fine… I’ll help trap the rat."

translation: Dobra… Pomogę złapać szczura.

source_text: I’m going to be late for work.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I’m going to be late for work.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I’m going to be late for work."

translation: Spóźnię się do pracy.

source_text: You go to Dick’s; I’ll stay behind and deal with the rat.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You go to Dick’s; I’ll stay behind and deal with the rat.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You go to Dick’s; I’ll stay behind and deal with the rat."

translation: Ty idź do Dick's; ja zostanę i zajmę się szczurem.

source_text: You’re my hero, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.You’re my hero, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.You’re my hero, 1Hero."

translation: Jesteś moim bohaterem, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m happy to help, Judy. Now you better get going so you’re not late.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’m happy to help, Judy. Now you better get going so you’re not late.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’m happy to help, Judy. Now you better get going so you’re not late."

translation: Chętnie pomogę, Judy. Teraz lepiej leć, by się nie spóźnić.

source_text: Will you visit after you catch the rat?

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Will you visit after you catch the rat?
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Will you visit after you catch the rat?"

translation: Odwiedzisz po złapaniu szczura?

source_text: I’ll stop by later.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ll stop by later.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ll stop by later."

translation: Wpadnę później.
